source: AAP Bright Futures Recommendations for Preventive Pediatric Health Care (Periodicity Schedule)
notes_to_renderer: Schedule reflects standard well-child cadence in year 1. Many pediatric practices add a 1-week visit and a 4-week visit, which are not on the AAP schedule but are routine in private practice.
Vaccines listed are the ones administered AT the well visit. Cross-reference vaccines.json for full schedule.

screenings_assessments: Critical congenital heart disease (CCHD) pulse-ox screen
Bilirubin (transcutaneous or serum, especially if risk factors)
questions_to_ask: What's the bilirubin trajectory and when do we need to recheck?
Is the latch effective? (if breastfeeding)
What's the expected weight loss in the first 5 days?
When will I see a lactation consultant?

screenings_assessments: Feeding assessment (output: ≥6 wet diapers/day, ≥3 stools/day by end of first week)
questions_to_ask: Is weight loss within the expected range (typical: 5–10% of birth weight, regained by day 10–14)?
Should we supplement with formula or expressed milk?
What does jaundice that warrants phototherapy look like vs. low-grade jaundice?

screenings_assessments: Growth parameters plotted on WHO curves
Maternal depression screen (Edinburgh Postnatal Depression Scale standard)
Developmental surveillance (responding to sound, lifting head briefly during tummy time)
Vision check (does she fix and follow?)
questions_to_ask: Is feeding/weight gain on track?
When do we transition out of the swaddle?
Any signs of GERD that warrant intervention?

screenings_assessments: CDC milestone surveillance: smiles socially, holds head up on tummy, makes sounds other than crying
Anticipatory guidance: 4-month sleep regression preview, solids planning
questions_to_ask: Is the timing right for sleep training / sleep hygiene routines?
When should we plan to introduce solids?
Any feedback on whether she's tracking on growth percentiles?

screenings_assessments: CDC milestones: head steady when held upright, coos, looks at hands, brings hands to mouth, pushes up on forearms during tummy time
questions_to_ask: Is she ready for solids at 6 months or earlier?
What's the readiness signal beyond the 4-month mark?
Recommended approach to night feedings going forward?

screenings_assessments: CDC milestones: rolls tummy-to-back, laughs, takes turns making sounds, reaches to grab a toy
Hemoglobin / iron screen (especially if exclusively breastfed — iron stores deplete around 6 mo)
Solid-foods readiness assessment (sits with support, lost tongue-thrust reflex, shows interest)
questions_to_ask: Iron status — supplement needed?
Allergen-introduction protocol — any reason to delay peanut/egg?
Are night wakings developmentally appropriate at this point?

screenings_assessments: CDC milestones: sits without support, gets to sitting position, rakes food with fingers, babbles 'mamamama'/'bababababa', stranger anxiety appropriate
Lead screen (if risk factors or per state protocol)
Standardized developmental screen (M-CHAT not yet — that's at 18 mo — but ASQ-3 may be done)
questions_to_ask: Is the iron screen normal?
Any concerns from the developmental screen?
Pulling-to-stand timing — should we already see it?

screenings_assessments: CDC milestones: pulls to stand, cruises, pincer grasp, says 'mama'/'dada' specifically, waves bye-bye, understands 'no'
Lead level (universal at 12 mo per CDC/state Medicaid; private insurance varies)
Transition off bottle, off formula (whole milk start), off crib bumpers (still relevant)
Anticipatory guidance: walking, table foods, cup, dental visit
questions_to_ask: Any speech/language concerns by 12 mo?
Recommended time for first dental visit (AAP says by age 1)?
When to drop the bottle entirely?
M-CHAT-R/F autism screen schedule (18 and 24 mo)?
